units.source_text: 庭中许多花木之中，樱花最为艳丽。

en.t: Among the many flowers and trees in the garden, the cherry blossoms were the most splendid.

units.source_text: 两女公子命侍女折取一枝，相与欣赏，赞道：“真美丽啊！别的花到底比不上它。”

en.t: The two young ladies had a maid break off one branch, admired it together, and praised it, saying, "How beautiful it is! No other flower can compare with it after all."

units.source_text: 长兄左近中将对她们说道：“你们小时候，两人争夺这株花树，

en.t: Their elder brother, the Sakon no Chujo, said to them, "When you were little, the two of you fought over this flowering tree,

units.source_text: 这个说‘这花是我的！’那个说‘这花是我的！’

en.t: one saying, 'This flower is mine!' and the other saying, 'This flower is mine!'

units.source_text: 父亲判断道：‘这花是姐姐的。’母亲判断道：‘这花是妹妹的。’

en.t: Father decided, 'This flower belongs to the elder sister,' while Mother decided, 'This flower belongs to the younger sister.'

units.source_text: 我那时虽然没有哭闹，但听了这话心中也很不高兴呢。”

en.t: I did not cry or make a fuss then, but hearing those words made me very displeased at heart."

units.source_text: 又说：“这株樱花已经是老树了。

en.t: He also said, "This cherry tree has already become an old tree.

units.source_text: 回想过去年月之中，许多人先我而死，便觉此身哀愁难于罄诉。”

en.t: When I think back over the years gone by, and of the many people who died before me, I feel that the sorrow of this life is beyond telling."

units.source_text: 他们时而哭泣，时而嬉笑，比平日更为悠闲。

en.t: They wept at times and laughed merrily at times, passing the day more leisurely than usual.

units.source_text: 原来这左近中将近已在某人家当女婿，难得回自邸从容盘桓。

en.t: As it happened, this Sakon no Chujo had recently become a son-in-law in another household, so he rarely returned to his own residence to linger at ease.

units.source_text: 今天被这樱花所牵惹，故逗留较久。

en.t: Today, drawn by these cherry blossoms, he stayed longer than usual.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍虽然已是许多长大成人的子女的母亲，

en.t: Although Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, was already the mother of many grown children,

units.source_text: 但相貌比年龄娇嫩得多，依然同青春盛年一样姣美。

en.t: her appearance was far more youthful than her age, and she remained as lovely as in the prime of youth.

units.source_text: 冷泉院大约至今还在爱慕玉鬘的容姿，

en.t: Reizei-in was probably still enamored of Tamakazura's beauty even now,

units.source_text: 回思往事，恋恋不忘，总想找个机会和她接近，因此竭诚盼望大女公子入侍。

en.t: and, remembering the past with lingering attachment, he kept looking for a chance to draw near her, so he earnestly hoped that the elder young lady would enter his service.

units.source_text: 关于大女公子入冷泉院的事，左近中将说道：“此事终非长策。

en.t: Regarding the elder young lady's entering Reizei-in's household, the Sakon no Chujo said, "In the end, this is not a sound long-term plan.

units.source_text: 无论何事，世人都爱合乎时宜。

en.t: In everything, people of the world favor what suits the times.

units.source_text: 冷泉院容貌之昳丽，固然令人赞仰，世间无有其类，

en.t: Reizei-in's beauty is certainly admirable, and there is none like it in the world,

units.source_text: 然而身已退位，盛时已过了。

en.t: but he has already abdicated, and his prime has passed.

units.source_text: 即使是琴笛之曲调、花之颜色、鸟之鸣声，亦必须合乎时宜，

en.t: Even the melodies of zithers and flutes, the colors of flowers, and the songs of birds must suit their proper season,

units.source_text: 方能悦人耳目。故与其入冷泉院，恐不如当太子妃吧？”

en.t: only then can they please people's ears and eyes. So rather than entering Reizei-in's household, would it not be better for her to become consort to the Crown Prince?"

units.source_text: 玉鬘答道：“也很难说呢。

en.t: Tamakazura replied, "That is hard to say as well.

units.source_text: 皇太子那边，早就有身份高贵的人专宠，无人能与并肩。

en.t: On the Crown Prince's side, a woman of high rank has long held his exclusive favor, and no one can stand beside her.

units.source_text: 勉强参加进去，生涯定多痛苦，而且难免被人耻笑，所以也要考虑。

en.t: If she forced her way in, her life would surely hold much suffering, and she could hardly avoid being laughed at, so this too must be considered.

units.source_text: 如果你父亲在世，则将来命运如何虽不可知，

en.t: If your father were still alive, then although no one could know what fate might bring in the future,

units.source_text: 目前总有荫庇，入宫亦不致受屈也。”

en.t: for the present she would certainly have his protection, and even if she entered court service, she would not be made to suffer indignity."

units.source_text: 说到这里，大家不胜感伤。

en.t: When the conversation reached this point, everyone was overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 左近中将等去后，两女公子继续下棋。

en.t: After the Sakon no Chujo and the others had gone, the two young ladies continued their game.

units.source_text: 戏将幼时争夺的樱花树作为赌物，说道：“三次中有两次胜的，樱花树归她所有。”

en.t: In play, they made the cherry tree they had fought over in childhood the stake, saying, "Whoever wins two out of three games shall own the cherry tree."

units.source_text: 天色渐暗，棋局移近檐前，侍女们将帘子卷起，各人都盼望自家的女主人占胜。

en.t: As the sky gradually darkened, the game board was moved near the eaves, the maids rolled up the blinds, and each of them hoped that her own mistress would win.
